# Two-fault study: one data fault + one checker fault (generated by tools/two_fault_study.py)

Data faults: every single fault outside the check region that the single-fault analysis certified 'covered, can corrupt the output'. Checker faults: every single fault in the check region. Verdicts by double-fault symbolic execution + the unchanged baseline classifier. GF(256).

## Pair verdicts

| program | data faults | checker faults | pairs | still covered | covered, output not corrupted | bypass (some state) | of which undetected on every state | unknown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| karatsuba 2x2 | 90 | 130 | 11700 | 6659 | 0 | 3444 | 268 | 1597 |
| schoolbook n=2 | 80 | 130 | 10400 | 5842 | 0 | 3205 | 304 | 1353 |
| cyclic mul n=2 | 100 | 180 | 18000 | 10896 | 0 | 5307 | 384 | 1797 |
| butterfly 4 | 150 | 400 | 60000 | 56201 | 0 | 3799 | 406 | 0 |

'bypass (some state)' means a state exists on which the output is wrong and the discrepancy is 0 for all challenges; for most pairs that state is special (the two error terms cancel) and its density among all states was not measured. 'Undetected on every state' means the faulted discrepancy is the zero polynomial.

## What the single-fault labels of checker faults conceal

| program | checker faults | single-fault labels | disable detection of EVERY data fault | enable a bypass for at least one data fault | only weaken a bound | cause unknown | harmless for every data fault | max bound increase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| karatsuba 2x2 | 130 | {'covered-no-wrong': 128, 'benign': 2} | 2 | 126 | 0 | 80 | 0 | 2 |
| schoolbook n=2 | 130 | {'covered-no-wrong': 128, 'benign': 2} | 2 | 122 | 4 | 86 | 0 | 2 |
| cyclic mul n=2 | 180 | {'covered-no-wrong': 178, 'benign': 2} | 2 | 160 | 16 | 126 | 0 | 2 |
| butterfly 4 | 400 | {'covered-no-wrong': 396, 'benign': 4} | 2 | 125 | 273 | 0 | 2 | 2 |

| karatsuba 2x2 | 2340 | 0 | 16 | 13.7 |
| schoolbook n=2 | 2080 | 0 | 23 | 10.1 |
| cyclic mul n=2 | 3600 | 0 | 42 | 16.3 |

## Examples of checker faults that disable detection completely

- karatsuba 2x2: `skip@21` on `['add', 'disc', 'eab', 'ep']`; `zero@21` on `['add', 'disc', 'eab', 'ep']`
- schoolbook n=2: `skip@20` on `['add', 'disc', 'eab', 'ep']`; `zero@20` on `['add', 'disc', 'eab', 'ep']`
- cyclic mul n=2: `skip@27` on `['add', 'disc', 'lhs', 'rhs']`; `zero@27` on `['add', 'disc', 'lhs', 'rhs']`
- butterfly 4: `skip@54` on `['add', 'disc', 'lhs', 'rhs']`; `zero@54` on `['add', 'disc', 'lhs', 'rhs']`
